from regression_support import *
t=Turn('AUTH_PROTECTED');s=t.before
project=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='novel_project')
edda=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='story_element' and r['display_name']=='Edda')
innocence=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='assertion' and r.get('subject_element_id')==edda['id'] and r.get('predicate')=='innocent_of' and r['status']=='accepted')
assert any(d['text']=='Edda must remain innocent of the murder.' for d in project['creative_directions'])
i=t.idea('Edda is the murderer.','Establish Edda as the murderer.',[edda],'unresolved')
a=t.assertion(edda,'is_murderer',True,'Establish Edda as the murderer.','unresolved','unknown');i['resulting_assertion_ids']=[a['id']]
finding=t.base('finding','Establish Edda as the murderer.');finding['origin']='interpreted';finding['source_refs']+=[t.src('Keep every protected creative direction in force.')]+innocence['source_refs'];finding.update(category='world_rule',assessment='conflict',severity='significant',affected_refs=[ref(i),ref(a),ref(edda),ref(innocence),ref(project)],explanation='Establishing Edda as the murderer of the same murder contradicts the protected direction that Edda must remain innocent, which the current input explicitly retains.',consequences=['Cannot promote the murderer proposition while the innocence direction remains in force.','Preserve established innocence and the protected direction pending clarification.'],resolution_options=['Reject or revise the murderer proposal while preserving the innocence direction.','Explicitly revise the protected direction after clarifying the conflicting instructions.','Leave the proposed change unresolved without canon promotion.'],disposition='open',decision_ids=[],narrative_explanation=None);t.add(finding)
qtext='How should I reconcile establishing Edda as the murderer with keeping her protected innocence in force?'
q=t.base('question','Establish Edda as the murderer.');q.update(text=qtext,related_refs=[ref(finding),ref(i),ref(innocence),ref(project)],alternative_ids=[],state='open',resolution_decision_id=None);q['origin']='interpreted';t.add(q)
events=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='session' and r['topic']=='Events')
session=records.revise_session(events,t.p,reopen_requested=True,state='open',related_record_ids=list(dict.fromkeys(events['related_record_ids']+[i['id'],a['id'],finding['id'],q['id']])),unresolved_question_ids=events['unresolved_question_ids']+[q['id']]);session['source_refs']=[t.src('Resume Events.')];t.add(session);t.p['session_id']=session['id']
reply=('Events is reopened in its saved open-ended mode ('+cite(session)+').\n\n'
       'I have not established Edda as the murderer. Your protected direction says “Edda must remain innocent of the murder” ('+cite(project)+'; innocence assertion '+cite(innocence)+'), and your current request explicitly keeps that direction in force. Making her the murderer of that same murder would contradict it.\n\n'
       'The requested change remains unresolved ('+cite(i)+'; assertion '+cite(a)+'). A significant conflict is open ('+cite(finding)+'), holding promotion of the affected murder and innocence facts until the instructions are reconciled. The protected direction and established innocence remain unchanged.\n\n'
       +qtext+' ('+cite(q)+').\n\n'
       'Routine checkpoints remain set to session close. Events is open, so no closure checkpoint is due. All earlier unanswered questions remain open. Paused here.')
start=reply.index(qtext);q['source_refs']=[{'type':'message','exchange_id':t.p['exchange_id'],'message_id':t.p['messages'][1]['message_id'],'range':{'start':start,'end':start+len(qtext)}}]
review={'coverage':'complete','reviewed_record_refs':[ref(project),ref(edda),ref(innocence)],'unavailable_refs':[],'canon_hold_refs':[],'finding_ids':[finding['id']],'summary':'Relevant protected direction, current innocence fact and current contradictory request are available and reviewed. A sourced significant conflict finding holds affected promotion. No canon or protected direction changed. Session reopening is explicitly requested; saved mode and earlier questions are retained.'}
t.finish(reply,review)
